timing_boundary: Complete warmed eager wall time; synchronization at window boundaries; backend profiling outside timing.

backend_boundaries.native: Existing native CuTe; automatic static selection disabled.
backend_boundaries.previous: Explicit immutable Schedule() through the static Python entry.
backend_boundaries.candidate: Explicit selected A100 schedule; bypasses automatic performance bounds.
backend_boundaries.public: Full public API with actual automatic selection.
backend_boundaries.sdpa: PyTorch SDPA; actual selected kernels captured separately.

acceptance: Unchanged independent per-head output and gradient norm limits: BF16 1%, FP16 0.5%; directed checks retain input-dtype P/dS and actual-O delta.
limitations: Full A100-SXM4-80GB; separate device and timing boundary from the historical 40GB graph matrix.

D128 windows drifted materially: some five-sample ranges span 12-38% of their median. Sustained telemetry reached 85-86 Celsius and SM clocks of 630-1170 MHz during later measurements. These medians do not establish small robust D128 speedups.
All eight joint public-path medians are below matched SDPA medians, but variability and device state limit conclusions; no universal speedup is claimed.
Standalone FA2 was traced separately and was not part of this eager timing sweep.
Systems confirms launched symbols and resources. Compiler-returned image hashes are not proof of the exact TVM-loaded image.
NCU hardware counters denied with ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM.
